beats.label: Step 1
beats.text: A **protein** gel goes on like a **fluoride** treatment.
beats.note: Hasan, Mata et al., Nature Communications 2025

beats.label: Step 2
beats.text: It seeps into **cracks** and pulls **calcium** and phosphate from **saliva.**

beats.label: Step 3
beats.text: In lab tests, new **enamel-like** crystals grew in about **2** weeks.

beats.label: Reality check
beats.text: No **human** trials reported yet. We found no sign it's **on sale.**
Follow to see if **lab** wins ever reach your **dentist.**
